cases.translation: Behold, Damascus will no longer be a city.
cases.explain: The noun Дамаск is the subject of the verb будет (will be).

cases.translation: It will become a heap of ruins.
cases.explain: The genitive case describes the material or composition of the heap.

cases.translation: The cities of Aroer will be abandoned.
cases.explain: The genitive expresses possession: cities of Aroer.

cases.translation: The fortified city will disappear from Ephraim.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with the sense of 'from within' uses the prepositional case.

cases.translation: In that day the glory of Jacob will fade.
cases.explain: The accusative expresses temporal duration or reference.

cases.sentence: Это будет похоже на жатву ___ пшеницы.
cases.translation: It will be like the harvest of wheat fields.
cases.explain: The genitive expresses the source or material: harvest of wheat fields.

cases.sentence: Останется лишь несколько ___, как остатки плодов.
cases.translation: Few people will remain, like remnants of fruit.
cases.explain: The noun человек is the subject of the verb останется (will remain).

cases.sentence: Когда обтрясают оливковое ___ во время сбора.
cases.translation: When they shake the olive tree during harvest.
cases.explain: The direct object of the transitive verb обтрясают (shake) requires the accusative case.

reading.ru: Вот, Дамаск больше не будет городом, он превратится в груду развалин.
reading.question: What will become of Damascus?
options: It will be destroyed and become a heap of ruins
It will be strengthened with new walls
It will become a prosperous city
reading.correct: It will be destroyed and become a heap of ruins
reading.explain: The text explicitly states Damascus will no longer be a city and will become ruins.

reading.ru: Города Араэра будут покинуты, брошены Атаром.
reading.question: What will happen to the cities of Aroer?
options: They will be abandoned and left desolate
They will be populated by new settlers
They will be fortified with walls
reading.correct: They will be abandoned and left desolate
reading.explain: The text says these cities will be forsaken and left desolate for animals to inhabit.

reading.ru: Исчезнет в Ефреме укрепленный город, и в Дамаске царская власть.
reading.question: What will disappear from Ephraim and Damascus?
options: The fortified city from Ephraim and the royal power from Damascus
reading.correct: The fortified city from Ephraim and the royal power from Damascus
reading.explain: The verse specifically mentions the disappearance of fortified cities and royal authority.

reading.ru: В тот день слава Иакова увянет, исхудает тучное тело его.
reading.question: What will happen to Jacob's glory in that day?
options: It will wither and his fat body will become lean
It will be forgotten by the people
reading.correct: It will wither and his fat body will become lean
reading.explain: The text describes Jacob's glory fading and his well-fed body becoming emaciated.

reading.ru: Останется лишь несколько людей, как остатки плодов на оливковом дереве.
reading.question: How many people will survive?
options: Only a few, like remnants of fruit left on olive trees
Half of the population will remain
reading.correct: Only a few, like remnants of fruit left on olive trees
reading.explain: The text uses the olive tree harvest metaphor to show how few survivors will remain.

reading.ru: В тот день люди посмотрят на своего Создателя, устремят взгляд на Святого Израилева.
reading.question: What will people do in that day?
options: They will look to their Maker and have respect for the Holy One of Israel
They will worship idols and false gods
They will celebrate with great joy
reading.correct: They will look to their Maker and have respect for the Holy One of Israel
reading.explain: The text states people will turn their attention to God and the Holy One of Israel.
